unit_statements_verbatim: This minor consists of one lower-division course, one upper-division course and 10 units of elective courses.

## Required Lower-Division Requirement (4 units)

---

- DANC 280g Introduction to Dance as an Art Form Units: 4

- DANC 333gw Origins of Jazz Dance Units: 4 or

## Dance Technique Courses*

---

Students with previous dance experience may place into intermediate (b-level), intermediate/advanced (c-level) and/or advanced (d-level) courses.

notes.text: The Dance in Entertainment Minor offers undergraduate students an opportunity to explore dance in the commercial realm, from Hollywood to Broadway, primarily focused on performance, choreography and dance entrepreneurship. The program offers a wide variety of courses in dance technique, theory, the business of dance and choreography.
notes.source_line: The Dance in Entertainment Minor offers undergraduate students an opportunity to explore dance in the commercial realm, from Hollywood to Broadway, primarily focused on performance, choreography and dance entrepreneurship. The program offers a wide variety of courses in dance technique, theory, the business of dance and choreography.

notes.text: This minor consists of one lower-division course, one upper-division course and 10 units of elective courses. Students must be in good academic standing to be admitted. No previous dance experience is required.
